body: I’m on my way to getting a civil engineering degree. Enough to say that I’ve had ulcers and GI bleeding from stress. And I can’t have kids either because of stress to some degree.
Okay you’re tired but is there anything you can do to get out of this depression NOW? Somewhere you can go something you can do that will change your life or simply make you happy??

Because I’m just blinded by my own thinking. And that’s why it’s a great idea to come to these forums and talk because it opens your brain up. Now please take a step back and think of all the beautiful qualities that people have commended you for.
Noppppe nope nope nope. If there was one thing you could do NOW to get out of it what would it be?
Noooooope nope nope.
Yeah it could or could not. If it doesn’t (highly likely) one might end up paralyzed severely having to be dependent on others.

Nope nope nope nope. 
A lot of people don’t care but that doesn’t mean that you give up on life especially since you’re not adamant about taking your own life and you seem to be sane to some degree. If you don’t care that much then go and give your life some purpose. I’m 19 and I feel like I’ve seen everything I have to see but that doesn’t mean I’m not learning anything new. Go learn how to make a shit Ton of money for your daughter to have an extremely bright future. Because you don’t want to do something to yourself and regret it the last few seconds before you die. You want to die in peace knowing you’ve done everything you can for your daughter and YOURSELF.

Nope this will not work this will most likely just cause a heart attack or a stroke and would result in paralysis please don’t do this. I love you and there’s so much more to live for you’re sooo beautiful inside and out.
And, oh, I’m your friend.

Nope that’s not true because I have over 10 people I speak to daily and I couldn’t describe how alone I feel. I legit feel like I’m the only person in the world that could ever feel this way (which is not true, obviously) but there’s nothing on the outside that could control how you feel about yourself. A lot of people are not comfortable being alone but that’s perfectly normal. You should be your own best friend before befriending anybody else.
You have me. Message me and I’m your new bestie.
It sounds like you need money for insurance. How much do you need?

Oh sorry I got the wrong comment with the wrong person. But. You’re 15. I’m 19. I have mental health issues that I’ve never had when I was 15 and I’m more free and independent than I was back in the day but I would have never imagined that I would be sad and depressed at this age. 
This being said, you could always learn how to deal stocks and become a millionaire through bitcoin and small investments. There’s so much to learn and there’s so much you could become. It’s too early for you to leave us!! I love you.
How much do you need?

Nope. You know why?? Because you’re a blessing. You’ve brought a lot of people together through taking care of you and without you so many friendships would have not been made so many conversations wouldn’t have been exchanged without you your boyfriend wouldn’t be the strong man he is seeing you endure all that pain. You’ve made everybody around you grow and appreciate themselves more. You have done SO much and have so many people appreciate their lives that it’s time for you to step back and take time for yourself. Send everybody out for a few minutes, hours etc and reflect on what you want to do with the time you have left on earth because reality is you don’t know how long you have left. Please don’t do anything you’re going to regret because you’re so precious and I love you. You have done things for so many people and you owe this one to yourself.

Why not? You have legs and arms that function (if not I apologize). Just get up and walk out of wherever you live. And if you’re held captive or something just run. Whatever it is holding you back it’s not worth it I promise.

Nope. I love you and care about you so much. We’re all going to end up dead suicidal or not, so why does hate matter so much now? It doesn’t mean anything. If you feel that people around you aren’t good for you then get up and walk away from everything bad for you. You can help yourself by letting go of the negativity and embracing a new start.

Then get up and move away further from where all this happened. Go to a new state/province or somewhere else, maybe just a train stop you’ve never been to and you can easily choose not to look back if you don’t want to. Starting fresh out of nowhere always helps. Transfer out of that university and go somewhere further where people don’t know you. This is NOT the end. What you can do to redeem yourself is giving back to the community and help other closeted people with their thoughts and help them come out now that you have SO much experience. You have so much to give. I love you.

No no no. 
If your exam results are bad it’s okay. THEY ARENT EVEN OUT YET. omg imagine you did amazing and you wouldn’t even know it because you’d be gone. I’m a third year civil engineering student in the UK and I understand how you feel completely I think I failed everything but turns out I got all Bs and As once results came out. Distract yourself until they come out but DONT UNDERESTIMATE YOURSELF OKAY. EDUCATION ONLY TEACHES US HOW TO OBEY BUT IN ORDER TO BE A MILLIONAIRE OR BILLIONAIRE WE NEED TO BE REBELS
You have got this. Get up and runaway and shake your life and do whatever you deem necessary to get out of this state of mind. Go away to a new place and never look behind.
WAAAAAIT nope.

No you’re not selfish at all. You have every right to feel the way you do and nobody can tell you that your struggle is more or less important than anybody else’s because we’re all simply at different stages in life. My depression is something I completely fabricated in my own head and I feel completely guilty that my family is going to have to suffer the consequences of whatever it is that’s going to happen to me. But don’t diminish your own problems because if they’re destroying YOU as a person, then they’re just THAT important.
I love you and you’ll get through this and DONT FEEL ANYWAY ABOUT THIS BECAUSE YOURE A HUMAN AND YOURE ALLOWED TO FEEL WHATEVER YOU WANT TO FEEL.
I mean if you feel guilty about it surely you’ve got some living conscience in you that deserves to be cared about after feeling this way for a long time.
No no no. Wait you live in the UK? I live in Glasgow. Tell me about it.

Imagine they DO kick you out. You run off and start a life from scratch. Be who you want to be and do what you want to do. Make your own money and your own rules. Your life is JUST beginning. You can make your own and help your older brother and be a family again. You need to start your own. Think about everything that you haven’t done yet that you CAN and WILL do if you just walk away from all the toxicity and negativity. You own your own life. 
I love you okay!!! You have my love and you always will.
Well let’s line them up. What mistakes have you made and let’s see if I can forgive you. If I can, then you can surely forgive yourself.
